name: Cold Snap
text: Freeze an enemy. Get a random Frost spell.
flavorText: Oh snappers!

name: First Flame
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. Add a Second Flame to your hand.
flavorText: You never forget your first love: fire.

name: Forbidden Shrine
text: Spend all your Mana. Cast a random spell that costs that much.
flavorText: Telling me not to use something just makes me want to use it more.

name: Mirror Dimension
text: Summon a 0/4 minion with Taunt. If you are holding a Dragon, summon another.
flavorText: Also summons two 4/0s.

name: Scrappy Scavenger
text: Battlecry: Discover a card with Cost equal to your remaining Mana Crystals.
flavorText: "One second, I'm stashing this Ultragigasaur in my little satchel."

name: Sleet Storm
text: Deal 2 damage. Deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
flavorText: Pocket snow!

name: Spark of Life
text: Choose One - Discover a Mage spell; or Discover a Druid spell.
flavorText: Just don't spark that life too close to the World Tree.

name: The Forbidden Sequence
text: Quest: Discover 8 cards. Reward: The Origin Stone.
flavorText: Day 9. We were not welcomed with open arms, but with spears! Fortunately, Chief Esho took pity on us and called off the guards. Learning of Elise's expertise, a Titanographer whisked her away to the library. Umbra disappeared in the twisting streets...

name: The Skeleton Key
text: Discover a spell, or refresh your options (20% chance to take 5 damage each refresh!)
flavorText: The skeleton belongs to the person who last tried to use it.

name: Time-Twisted Seer
text: Has Spell Damage +2 while damaged.
flavorText: They should really get some glasses for that.

name: Violet Spellwing
text: Deathrattle: Add an 'Arcane Missiles' spell to your hand.
flavorText: A bird in the hand is worth three missiles in the grave.

name: Winterspring Whelp
text: Battlecry: Discover a 1-Cost spell from any class.
flavorText: It's important to explore other classes while learning to spread your wings!

name: Coilbearer
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell to put on top of your deck. It costs (2) less.
flavorText: Always complains about getting topdecked.

name: Constellar's Calling
text: Choose a friendly minion. Summon a random minion of the same Cost.
flavorText: Constellar spam calls about installing astral energy panels became an annoyance all throughout the cosmos.

name: Contraband Wands
text: Get 3 Arcane Missiles.
flavorText: The cake is a lie.

name: Discs of Norgannon
text: Move all spells in your deck to the top. You can pick to draw from the top or bottom each turn.
flavorText: Finally, SOMEONE who uses a coaster.

name: Divination
text: Destroy a friendly Wisp to draw 3 cards.
flavorText: Stop! It's already dead!

name: Faceless Enigma
text: Battlecry: Look at 2 random Secrets. Pick one to cast for yourself. The other casts for your opponent.
flavorText: I only share secrets with my most intimate friends and enemies.

name: Frostbolt
text: Deal 3 damage to a character and Freeze it.
flavorText: It is customary to yell "Chill out!" or "Freeze!" or "Ice ice, baby!" when you play this card.

name: Khadgar
text: Your cards that summon minions summon twice as many.
flavorText: "What do you call two minions summoned at once? Twinions, haha! Wait... where are you going?"

name: Leyline Nexus
text: Draw a card. It costs (1) less.
flavorText: Sometimes I just paint purple lines on the ground and call it a Leyline.

name: Mystic Runesaber
text: Elusive Battlecry: Increase the effects of your Leylines by 1 this game.
flavorText: And the cat came back, the very next ley.

name: Raincaller
text: The first time you deal damage with a spell each turn, gain +2 Attack.
flavorText: I bless the rains down in Nazjatar...

name: Runed Orb
text: Deal 2 damage. Discover a spell.
flavorText: The most dangerous Winter Veil ornament.

name: Semi-Stable Portal
text: Rewind Add a random minion to your hand. It costs (3) less.
flavorText: Portal technology has advanced so much! We're down to spending only 29% of GDP on upkeep.

name: Smoldering Grove
text: Draw 1 (card, cards). (Upgrades each turn, but discards after 3!)
flavorText: To be clear, the grove is not SUPPOSED to be smoldering.

name: Spirit Gatherer
text: Battlecry: Get a Wisp. Imbue your Hero Power.
flavorText: They call him the Wisp Whisperer.

name: Stellar Balance
text: Get a Moonfire and a Starfire. Give them Spell Damage +1.
flavorText: Famously, Moonfire and Starfire are about equal in power.

name: Story of the Waygate
text: Reduce the Cost of cards in your hand that didn't start in your deck by (1).
flavorText: "...and then a lot of people got mad."

name: Thaw From Ice
text: Assemble a Mage minion. At the end of your turns, reduce its Cost by (1).
flavorText: Ah shoot I forgot to take the minion out of the freezer.

name: Unearthed Artifacts
text: Summon a random 2-Cost minion. If you've Discovered this turn, summon a random 4-Cost minion instead.
flavorText: The Tortollans live so long they're unearthing their OWN artifacts!

name: Arcane Barrage
text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy and 2 damage to two other random ones.
flavorText: Arrrrrr I got me cane and I'm gonna barrage you with it!

name: Arcane Intellect
text: Draw 2 cards.
flavorText: Playing this card makes you SMARTER. And let's face it: we could all stand to be a little smarter.

name: Babbling Bookcase
text: Battlecry: Add 2 random Mage spells to your hand.
flavorText: Babbling Bookcase is quickly becoming one of my favorite cards. It's just so positive and generous. Practically costs nothing at all at three mana you drop him on the board and that chill guy gives you two spells to use later in the game.

name: Conjuration Specialist
text: Battlecry: Choose a spell in your hand. Split it into two random spells of the same Cost.
flavorText: Specialist is a very polite way of saying she only knows one spell.

name: Conjured Bookkeeper
text: Deathrattle: Draw a spell. Kindred: Summon a copy of this.
flavorText: In charge of cleaning up after the Library Rager.

name: Cosmic Springs
text: Draw a card. If it's not a minion, refresh two Mana Crystals.
flavorText: You can be my Cosmic Spriiinnnngggssss.

name: Counterspell
text: Secret: When your opponent casts a spell, Counter it.
flavorText: What's the difference between a mage playing with Counterspell and a mage who isn't? The mage who isn't is getting Pyroblasted in the face.

name: Eternal Firebolt
text: Lifesteal Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, return this to your hand at the end of your turn.
flavorText: Did I forget to turn off the Eternal Oven?

name: Explosive Runes
text: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, deal 6 damage to it and any excess to their hero.
flavorText: Sometimes it's safer NOT to read the warning signs.

name: Flames of Infinity
text: Secret: When your enemy's turn ends, deal INFINITE damage to their highest Health minion.
flavorText: This card is total overkill.

name: Foreboding Freeze
text: Freeze an enemy. Summon a random 5-Cost minion and Freeze it.
flavorText: More like Fiveboding Freeze.

name: Ice Barrier
text: Secret: When your hero is attacked, gain 8 Armor.
flavorText: This is Rank 1. Rank 2 is Chocolate Milk Barrier.

name: Ley Walker
text: Battlecry: Your Leylines cost (1) less this game. Deathrattle: Get a random Leyline.
flavorText: Ley! I'm walkin' here!

name: Mystic Misdirection
text: Secret: When an enemy minion attacks, transform it into a 1/1 Sheep.
flavorText: "Knock knock." "Who's there?" "Distracting Sheep." "Distracting sheep wh- BAAAHHHH!"

name: Oasis Ally
text: Secret: When a friendly minion is attacked, summon a 3/6 Water Elemental.
flavorText: As gentle as a bellyflop.

name: Q'onzu
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell. Choose to keep it or put it on top of your opponent's deck.
flavorText: "Where did Sarge go? Anyone seen Sarge?" - Harth

name: Scorching Winds
text: Deal 3 damage. Discard a random Fire spell to deal 3 more.
flavorText: It's like the old saying goes: where there's smoke, there's often fire... and where there's fire, there's often more fire.

name: Spire Security
text: Battlecry: Reveal a spell in your deck. If it costs (5) or more, deal 5 damage split among enemy minions.
flavorText: One does not simply walk out of The Violet Hold. Its gates are guarded by more than just Boulderfist Ogres. There is evil there that does not sleep, and Spire Security's great eye is ever watchful.

name: Starsurge
text: Deal damage to a minion. (Improved by each friendly minion that died this game.)
flavorText: "The stars urge you to DIE."

name: Storage Scuffle
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Costs (0) if you've Discovered this turn.
flavorText: Flip and file! Mix and shuffle! Sort and swap! Do the Storage Scuffle!

name: Timelooper Toki
text: Battlecry: Get 3 random spells from the past. When you play ALL 3, get another Timelooper Toki.
flavorText: Well this loop's a wash. Let's meditate until the next one.

name: Vault Breaker
text: After you Discover a card, reduce its Cost by (1).
flavorText: I've already told him 3 times to PUSH.

name: Alter Time
text: Discover two Arcane spells from the past. They cost (2) less.
flavorText: Spells from the past and future are adjusted for inflation.

name: Arcane Flow
text: Shatter Deal 4 damage. Deal 2 damage to all enemies. Deal 4 damage. Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
flavorText: Super excited to combo this with ERROR MISPLACED CARD

name: Archmage Kalec
text: Battlecry: Give all spells in your hand and deck Spell Damage +1.
flavorText: Kalec comes, Kalec goes.

name: Astral Rain
text: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy minion, five times.
flavorText: Some stay dry and others feel the pain.

name: Bursting Leyline
text: Deal 4 damage to a random enemy minion. Excess damage hits the enemy hero.
flavorText: When you gotta go, you gotta go.

name: Fireball
text: Deal 6 damage.
flavorText: This spell is useful for burning things. If you're looking for spells that toast things, or just warm them a little, you're in the wrong place.

name: Fragment of Nothing
text: After you cast a spell on a minion, draw a card.
flavorText: This is how much it cares.

name: Inferno Herald
text: After you cast a Fire spell, get a random Elemental and reduce its Cost by (3).
flavorText: Poor Inferno Herald, why so blue?

name: Merry Moonkin
text: At the end of your turn, gain Armor. (Improved by Wisps you control!)
flavorText: Merry Wispmas!

name: Sheep Mask
text: Set a minion's stats to 1/1 and give it "Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to all minions."
flavorText: Baa, Baa, Bomb Sheep

name: Surge Needle
text: Battlecry: Your Leylines trigger an additional time this game.
flavorText: Scalpel... Tweezers... Surge Needle... I said Surge Needle!

name: Unstable Spellcaster
text: Spell Damage +1 Battlecry: If you dealt damage with a spell this turn, summon a copy of this.
flavorText: 1, 2, 3, 4, I declare a spell war.

name: Windswept Pageturner
text: After you summon an Elemental, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
flavorText: This story will blow you away.

name: Algeth'ar Instructor
text: Spell Damage +2
flavorText: For my first lesson, spell "damage."

name: Astral Mediator
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Cast a random 3-Cost spell.
flavorText: Alright teams let's get out there and have ourselves a fair Cosmic War and remember, have fun!

name: Azure Queen Sindragosa
text: Fabled If you control another Dragon, your Arcane spells cost (2) less.
flavorText: Once Malygos' beloved mate, Sindragosa was among the first to suspect the corruption that had overtaken Neltharion. She came to regret not trusting her suspicions.

name: Bitter End
text: Freeze a minion and its neighbors. Destroy any that are damaged.
flavorText: Also comes in Sweet, Salty, Sour, and Umami.

name: Bootleg Alchemist
text: Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand. Transform it into a spell that costs (5) more (keeps its original Cost).
flavorText: Careful! This potion has a bit of a KICK to it!

name: Breakout Architect
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell that costs (5) or more. It casts twice when played.
flavorText: Oh nah, these aren't maps! It's... uh... just arcane hopscotch!

name: Crystallized Leyline
text: Summon a random 6-Cost minion.
flavorText: This crystal has healing properties.... and this crystal summons an army of minions.

name: Icebelt Magi
text: Battlecry: Draw two cards. For each that isn't a minion, summon a 3/6 Water Elemental.
flavorText: Fun fact! Saturn's rings are 95% Water Elemental.

name: Jailhouse Manastorm
text: Battlecry: After you cast a spell this game, summon a random minion of the same Cost.
flavorText: “Millhouse Manastorm, I'm coming for you!” His wife’s words haunted him ever since she escaped from Violet Hold. One night, he heard a strange ZAP! as he stepped through a portal, and found himself nearly a decade in the past - Millificent’s cold cell waiting for him.

name: Sindragosa's Triumph
text: Deal 8 damage to a minion. Reduce the Cost of a random card in your hand by the excess damage.
flavorText: When Sindragosa and her beloved fight side by side, nothing can stand in their way.

name: Tribute Dance
text: Choose a minion. Choose a different minion to transform it into.
flavorText: This is just a tribute.

name: Tricksy Improviser
text: Prepare Battlecry: If you've cast a spell this turn, cast two random Mage Secrets.
flavorText: Welcome to Dalaran, where the spells are made up and the points don't matter!

name: Wisprider
text: Battlecry: Imbue your Hero Power, then trigger it.
flavorText: "I surf dead people."

name: Arrival of the Titans
text: Draw 2 spells. Refresh 6 Mana Crystals. You can only play spells for the rest of the turn.
flavorText: "Hey guys check this out, they just lost their fifth game in a row!"

name: Blizzard
text: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions and Freeze them.
flavorText: This spell can be very Entertaining.

name: Isiset
text: Battlecry: Summon two 10/10 Constructs. They are Frozen until you spend 15 Mana on spells.
flavorText: To craft a star from nothing would require tremendous power. Thus, Isiset was created as a font of limitless magic so she may further tend to the celestial garden.

name: The Arcanomicon
text: Get all 3 Leylines. Choose an upgrade for your Leylines.
flavorText: Pondering my Orb.

name: Titanographer Osk
text: Gains a random Titan ability in your hand that changes each turn.
flavorText: Look at this Titangraph.

name: Anomalize
text: Summon a random 10 and 1-Cost minion. Scramble their stats.
flavorText: Only nominally anomalous.

name: Archmage Antonidas
text: Whenever you cast a spell, add a 'Fireball' spell to your hand.
flavorText: Antonidas was the Grand Magus of the Kirin Tor, and Jaina's mentor. This was a big step up from being Grand Magus of Jelly Donuts.

name: Astromancer
text: Battlecry: Summon a random minion with Cost equal to your hand size.
flavorText: All signs point to Antonidas.

name: Code Violet
text: Prepare. Summon an 8-Cost minion. If you've cast 3 other spells this turn, do it again. ( left!) (Ready!)
flavorText: Above Code Red but just below Code Ultraviolet.

name: Deep Freeze
text: Freeze an enemy. Summon two 3/6 Water Elementals.
flavorText: "Dancing with the Satyrs… on Ice!"

name: Flamestrike
text: Deal 5 damage to all enemy minions.
flavorText: When the ground is on fire, you should not stop, drop, and roll.

name: Relic of Kings
text: Discover a spell from any class that costs (8) or more. It costs (1).
flavorText: "Whoa, found a big plate!"

name: Techysaurus
text: Taunt. Costs (1) less for each card you played this game that didn't start in your deck.
flavorText: The field of dino prosthetics was nearly extinct before the Tortollans came around.

name: Temporal Construct
text: Battlecry: Deal 5 damage to an enemy minion. Draw cards equal to the excess damage.
flavorText: Time is a construct. Here it is.

name: Vulcanos
text: Colossal +2 At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage to all other minions.
flavorText: Determined to see Azeroth aflame, Ragnaros awakened a living volcano to send rivers of lava across the Barrens.

name: Aessina
text: Battlecry: If 20 friendly minions have died this game, deal 20 damage split among all enemies. ( left!) (Ready!)
flavorText: The Mother Wisp is a mysterious figure to most mortals, but to Ysera, she is a dear friend and companion.

name: Spellweaver's Brilliance
text: Summon a 6/6 Dragon. Costs (1) less for each damage you dealt with spells this turn.
flavorText: Oh you think you're sooOOOOooo smart? *pyroblasts them*
